forbiddenReconstructions: Do not synthesize 48 cards by arbitrarily subdividing the current 30 R17 cards.
Do not back-port the later v1.87 51-card architecture as though it were v1.83.
Do not assign v1.83 card IDs, full block ranges, or cue ranges that are not recovered from donor evidence.
Do not treat triangulated semantic boundaries as recovered v1.83 card IDs or full ranges.
Do not mark the tenth Canon split recovered from later v1.87/v1.89/v0.x granularity without an exact lineage delta.
Do not use this historical ledger to demote, replace, or re-block the certified source-first LIVE runtime.
recoveryAcceptance: Recover v1.81 or v1.83 donor bytes, or an exact contemporaneous enumeration of all 48 cards.
Bind every recovered card to canonical macro/block/cue ownership.
Prove exactly 48 ordered LIVE cards with complete, non-overlapping coverage.
Keep Host and Chalice consecration/elevation independently testable.
Preserve C0173→C0174 and C0180→C0181 as explicit elevation gates.
Preserve the v1.83 Gradual repair: B021 on the Gradual surface, B022 not merged into it, and B023 begins Munda cor meum.
Any future exact v1.83 48-card recovery remains compatibility evidence and must not override the certified source-first LIVE runtime without a separate architecture decision.
